title: Sources Sought: Hand Held Assembly (NSN: 6665-01-568-0616)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC-DTA.W6QK ACC- DTA
detail_text: The Army Contracting Command - Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) is seeking to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities, and qualifications of various members of the community, to include both small and large businesses, for production of the military-unique component listed below. Noun: Hand Held Assembly NSN: 6665-01-568-0616 Part No: 5-15-32277 FAT: Required Responses to this survey will assist ACC-DTA in planning for a potential contract. Interested vendors are encouraged to complete the survey located under "Attachments/Links" and then return it via e-mail to: Kim Parisek Contract Specialist, ACC-DTA EMAIL: kimberly.j.parisek.civ@army.mil Subject Line: Hand Held Assembly Survey Response You may respond in total, or in part, to the survey. However, all responses must be received no later than 2:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on Monday, 13-APR-2026. PLEASE NOTE: The associated Technical Data Package (TDP) will only be made available to vendors if/when a solicitation is released.
